name: agent-autonomous-developer
description: Turns agent-project-issues tickets into draft pull requests for projects in any language (stack auto-detected). Ships three skills — dispatch (model-facing lane-aware entry point), orchestrate-tickets (fleet orchestrator, main-checkout lane), and process-ticket (end-to-end ticket pipeline, worktree lane) — backed by five subagents. Drives the agent-project-issues and agent-worktree MCPs.
